lines.text: One more thing before you go. The Grumps don't just wander: they hold roads, ridges, whole valleys. One brave farmer can't take a valley alone.
Cat-topia has had to stand together before, every paw in its place. Come and practise with me in the orchard field: points, helpers, rallies. Nobody gets hurt. Grumps get turned back, not beaten.
Training is on the campaign map: MENU > Map > Campaign map > Training.

effects.hint: Catkins will train you to lead an army: MENU > Map > Campaign map > Training. Campaigns open new regions.

lines.text: Farmer! The Grumps hold the roads out of here. Drill with me before you try to take one: MENU > Map > Campaign map > Training.

effects.hint: Catkins will train you to lead an army: MENU > Map > Campaign map > Training.

lines.text: The burner phone from the coat buzzes. Not the number that was in it: a new one. It's Sal. Of course Sal has the number.
Lying low's fine. But the President's people hold every road out of here, and you don't take a road with one pair of fists.
I ran crews before I ran out of luck. Meet me in the orchard field for a drill: points, drones, rallies. Then I'll show you the real job: the highway out of here.
Training is on the campaign map: MENU > Map > Campaign map > Training.

effects.hint: Sal will drill you on running a crew in a fight: MENU > Map > Campaign map > Training. Campaigns open new turf.

lines.text: Boss. Before you try for the docks or the highway: a drill with me. MENU > Map > Campaign map > Training. The highway's the real job; I'll show you after.

effects.hint: Sal will drill you: MENU > Map > Campaign map > Training.

lines.text: You dream of a board covered in little flags. Every region past home has its own campaign, and each one asks for a team and provisions. The campaign map lists what's missing.
The Ember Grumps along the ridge are warm crystals now, glowing in the snow. Nobody had to be scared of that road again.
We came round by the frozen ridge, under the stars. The Grumps never even looked up. Slow, but nobody got hurt.
The campaign's still out there if you want its prizes. No rush.
The great tree's branches are quiet. The Storm Grumps sat down in the clouds and sparkled. Climb it from the forest when you're ready.
Big Jim led you up the inside of the great tree while the Storm Grumps slept. The branches creaked like an old friend.
The campaign's still out there if you want its prizes. No rush.
The back roads hum again. A farmer waves from her porch, and the President's lookouts are nowhere to be seen.
A trucker owed Sal a favour. You rode out under a tarp in the sleeper cab, and the countryside opened up past the toll booth.
The campaign's still out there if you want the prize money. Your call, boss.
The piers are ours. The fishers tie up without paying anyone, and somebody's already singing on the boardwalk.
A fisher rowed you in under the piers at night. Nobody on the docks saw a thing. Sal grins: that's how you do it.
The campaign's still out there if you want the prize money. Your call, boss.
The signs on the strip flicker to new colours. Shopkeepers stand in their doorways, watching the street like it's theirs again.
Halo mapped the service alleys behind the strip. You slipped through by the bins and the back doors, and the neon district let you in.
The campaign's still out there if you want the prize money. Your call, boss.
The pumps run, the tunnels are lit, and the people down here can walk home without looking over their shoulders.
An old pump worker owed Doc a kindness. A maintenance key, a ladder, a long dark walk, and you're in the underground.
The campaign's still out there if you want the prize money. Your call, boss.
Uptown's doormen don't stop you any more. Somewhere up in the tower, the President has noticed.
Sasha's old cleaning shift pass still works. A clean uniform, a nod at the staff entrance, and Uptown is open to you.
The campaign's still out there if you want the prize money. Your call, boss.
